profile_text.body:
Snap Inc is a public company headquartered in Santa Monica, California, traded under the ticker SNAP. On its own site, the company describes itself as believing the camera presents the greatest opportunity to improve the way people live and communicate, and says it contributes to human progress by empowering people to express themselves, live in the moment, learn about the world, and have fun together.

The material available on the company's AI products and position is thin. No products are tracked for Snap Inc, and no MCP servers are listed. The company's profile records its CIK as 0001564408 and its organization type as a for-profit public company.

On litigation, no cases are listed for Snap Inc. A law exposure record counts 281 cases in California.
